sources.quote: SUP-C,Meccanica Chisone S.r.l.,aluminium extrusions and blanks

findings.why: No controlled record in the documents gives an approval for BR-225 from SUP-C. The records cover only BR-220, BR-180 and BR-310. The supplier master lists SUP-C only as a supplier. It has no part, plant or customer release. BR-225 is also not linked to any program or customer in the documents. Missing approval is therefore not evidence that the source is not approved. A person must confirm whether a current release exists for BR-225 x receiving plant x customer.
